title: TenantQuotaSetting
description: DD-123/DD-165: tenant.quota.set parameters. Writes only the Tenant Customer's hard-limit OpenMeter entitlement for the platform feature, resetting monthly; memberLimitPerPeriod (only knowledge_answers and data_queries) is the per-member cap kept in the same entitlement's metadata. A setting without it removes the member cap.

memberLimitPerPeriod.description: DD-165(3): per-member cap per period; only for quota items with a member dimension (knowledge_answers, data_queries).
